// WHAT YOU GET

EVERYTHING
YOU NEED

A full-stack homebrew platform that grows with your process, not against it.

🍺
RECIPE BUILDER

Full grain bill, hop schedule, water chemistry, mash profile, and OG/FG/ABV/IBU/SRM estimates — all calculated live as you build.

⏱
BREW DAY WORKFLOW

Guided step-by-step timer pulled from your recipe. Strike water, mash-in, sparge, boil, chill — every step tracked with live countdowns.

💧
WATER CHEMISTRY

Full mineral and salt additions with Auto Fix. Target Pilsen, Balanced, Hoppy, or custom profiles. Live mash pH estimation built in.

📊
TARGET vs ACTUAL

Log your measured gravities and volumes. Color-coded variance dashboard shows you exactly how each brew tracked against the plan.

☁
CLOUD LIBRARY

Save unlimited recipes to your account. Load, rename, or duplicate anytime from any browser, any device.

🌎
COMMUNITY RECIPES

Browse and import recipes shared by the community. Filter by style. Submit your own. One click to load and start brewing.

🔬
EDIT LIBRARIES

Customize the built-in ingredient databases — water profiles, grains, hops, and yeast — to match exactly what you brew with.

📄
EXPORT PDF

One-click PDF export of your full recipe and brew day notes. Print it, share it, or archive every batch permanently.

🎨
FULL CUSTOMIZATION

Theme presets plus per-color overrides for backgrounds, accents, text, and borders. Custom app title, subtitle, and logo upload.
